docs: Stock disponible = SUM(mard.labst::numeric) (stock a utilisation libre)
Valorisation stock = quantite * mbew.verpr (PMP) ou mbew.stprs (prix standard)
joins: mara<->mbew sur matnr [valorisation ; mbew.bwkey=domaine de valorisation, souvent = division (werks)]
enums: mara.mtart=type (FERT=produit fini, HALB=semi-fini, ROH=matiere premiere, HAWA=marchandise)
mara.spart=secteur ; mara.meins=unite de base ; divisions du projet: marc.werks IN ('2200','9200')
rules: matnr a des zeros de tete -> LTRIM(matnr,'0').
Stock = SUM(mard.labst::numeric) (varchar). Libelle = makt.maktx (spras='F'). Valorisation = mbew.verpr/stprs (::numeric).

patterns.sql: SELECT LTRIM(a.matnr,'0') AS matnr, t.maktx, SUM(d.labst::numeric) AS stock FROM raw_data.mara a JOIN raw_data.makt t ON t.matnr=a.matnr AND t.spras='F' JOIN raw_data.mard d ON d.matnr=a.matnr GROUP BY a.matnr, t.maktx
